Subject: Readout and owners: FernoHealth dedicated GPU isolation & scaling

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the call earlier today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have a shared record. I captured the main pain points, your goals, and an initial technical footprint for a reserved/dedicated deployment:

Pain points we heard
- Latency spikes during peak inference windows (high variance P95/P99 for real-time routing).
- Multi-tenant data isolation concerns: PHI must be segmented and we need customer-controlled KMS.
- Unpredictable unit cost when running on general-purpose shared pools (want predictable monthly cost).

Goals / success criteria
- SLO: P95 generation latency < 200ms for our common 512-token workflows (goal to tune further during bench).
- Isolation: Tenant-dedicated GPU pools with encryption-in-flight and CMK support.
- Cost predictability: reserved capacity with burst policy for 20% spike windows; target unit cost reduction vs. shared of ~30%.

Initial proposal (high level)
- Dedicated pool: 12 x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved), isolated VPC with customer KMS integration.
- Burst: Configurable burst to shared-capacity for non-PHI inference; enforced routing policy for PHI-only to dedicated pool.
- Ops: 24/7 incident escalation with SLA-backed availability (target 99.9% uptime), and per-token billing floor for reserved windows.

Attachments:
- ferno_capacity_estimate.xlsx (capacity breakdown & cost model)
- ferno_health_playbook.pdf (ops runbook + isolation controls)

Next steps (owners & dates)
1) Technical deep dive (security + infra): schedule for week of Apr 27 — owner: Ben Carter (SE).
2) Compliance session (legal + security artifacts): provide SOC2 / encryption details — owner: Jordan Blake (AM), target May 4.
3) Draft SOW & pricing: we’ll share initial SOW and reserved-term pricing by May 1 — owner: Mina Haddad.

Please reply with any corrections to the summary, and your availability for the deep-dive. If procurement has a timeline, share that as well so we can align commercial cadence.

Thanks —
Mina

Thanks, Mina — this is a good summary and captures the discussion. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Latency SLA: Our initial internal ask is P95 < 150ms for the 256-token path; we understand this will depend on model choice and quantization but wanted to flag the tighter target.
2) KMS/keys: Our security team requires customer-managed keys (CMK) and a proof of key custody (HSM-backed). Can you confirm Redwood supports bring-your-own-KMS for Private/Dedicated?
3) Procurement timeline: we’re aiming for an executive decision by end of Q3 — procurement will need a commercial term sheet and an updated SOW.

We can make time for the technical deep dive week of Apr 27. Preferred days: Apr 28 or 29 in the morning PST.

Sara Liu
Head of ML Infrastructure | FernoHealth
